sourceAssessment: UI changes route maintained labels, descriptions and operation-status copy through the locale host. They do not change the 24 UI recipe IDs, Field Kit CSS tokens, DOM ownership or apply semantics.

Effects input changes localize visible state and actor descriptions and mechanically format the same renderers. Actor geometry, trail cells, collision footprints, sprite construction and effect recipe IDs remain unchanged.

Audio input changes localize controls, credits, diagnostics and live flight announcements. Playback state, volume values, selected procedural recipes, soundtrack bytes, rights metadata and transport behavior remain unchanged.

The local browser review exposed two live flight announcements that still bypassed the catalogue. Commit 4a17384455379aa8cc0a39454b47158d7b440570 routes those announcements and the adjacent event fallbacks through exact English/Ukrainian keys and adds a focused regression check.
